name: Johannes Kepler
about: Johannes Kepler (2011-007A), a crewed vehicle (ATV), launched 2011 Feb 16. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2011 Feb 19), held fixed
docked to S26400; GCAT's later phases (auxiliary catalogues) are not read yet
